column1: # Pairs no rule generates, plus identity entries (same on both sides) for words a
# rule or the classifier would otherwise get wrong. Identity entries short-circuit
# --- non-assimilative ь that Narkamaŭka keeps (a rule would strip it) ---
# --- эў- words that are the same in both orthographies ---
# --- native words with hard л that the classifier must leave alone ---
# --- native е that is not loan э ---
# --- Genitive plural -аў. NOT §80 — that is the German ei rule (Ляйпцыг); Збор 2005 is a
# --- spelling code and does not legislate declension. Source: project owner's instruction.
# --- Taraškievica extends the -аў/-яў genitive plural to
# --- feminine and neuter nouns in a vowel, but for many words both forms are permissible,
# --- so this is a whitelist rather than a rule: a blanket conversion corrupts ordinary
# --- text. Words where -аў is strongly preferred, on the project owner's instruction.
# --- хвіліна is deliberately absent: хвілін and хвілінаў are both valid.
# --- краін ↔ краінаў is two-way (it predates this list and is covered by
# --- tests/test_codification_2005.py). The five added here are one-way (n2t): the
# --- Taraškievica form is supplied going forward, but -аў arriving in T → N is left as
# --- it is, because both forms are permissible and the gold keeps справаў.
# --- аналаг: the noun restores the etymological о (аналог → аналёг); the adjective
# --- keeps akanne's а (аналагічны → аналягічны, handled by the `аналаг` loan stem).
# --- Genitive singular -у (§71). Taraškievica gives masculine loanwords naming
# --- institutions, abstractions and structural concepts the genitive singular -у/-ю
# --- where Narkamaŭka writes -а: унівэрсытэту, інстытуту, парлямэнту.
# --- A whitelist, for the same reason the genitive plural in -аў is one: nothing in the
# --- spelling of a word says whether it is an abstraction or a countable thing, and
# --- masculine -а is also the ending of concrete nouns that keep it. Guessing the class
# --- from the form would rewrite ordinary text. Extending the list is one line per word.
# --- Forward-only (n2t), and that asymmetry is the whole point: Narkamaŭka -а is
# --- unambiguously the genitive, but Taraškievica -у is genitive *or* dative, and
# --- Narkamaŭka spells the dative -у too. Mapping it back would turn "дзякуючы
# --- інстытуту" into "дзякуючы інстытута". Going T → N the ending is left alone:
# --- under-converting an ambiguous form beats corrupting an unambiguous one.
# --- Checked against GrammarDB rather than assumed: бюджэт, візіт, транзіт, дэпазіт,
# --- крэдыт, дэфіцыт, дызайн, візіт, крызіс and аналіз already take -у in Narkamaŭka,
# --- nothing to convert. паразіт is deliberately absent — §71 covers abstractions and
# --- institutions, and a parasite is a concrete animate noun whose -а is obligatory.
# --- праект is absent for the same reason, and it is the clearest case: the word is
# --- abstract in one use and concrete in another. «без пісьмовай згоды праекта» names
# --- an entity and keeps -а; a design or plan would take -у. Nothing in the form says
# --- which, and adding it cost the project its only N → T false positive.
# --- крытэрый → крытэр (§11б). A lemma change, not a stem change: Narkamaŭka's -ый
# --- noun has a -ыя/-ыю/-ыем declension and Taraškievica's is a plain hard-stem
# --- masculine, so every form is mapped explicitly. Forward only — крытэру is the
# --- genitive *and* the dative, and Narkamaŭka spells the dative крытэрыю.
# --- камп’ютэр is a recognised Taraškievica variant (§53 prefers кампутар). Narkamaŭka
# --- writes камп’ютар, so this only ever runs T → N: the variant normalises, and the
# --- forward direction is left to the `камп’ютар` stem.
